description_en: Queries the peak connection information of ports on an Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance
description_zh: 查询DDoS高防实例的端口连接峰值信息
name: DescribePortMaxConns

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance belongs in Resource Management. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group
parameters.help_zh: DDoS高防实例在资源管理产品中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The end time of the query. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.
The value must be on the minute
parameters.help_zh:
查询结束时间。时间戳格式，单位：秒。
必须为整点分钟
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The start time of the query. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.
The value must be on the minute
parameters.help_zh:
查询开始时间。时间戳格式，单位：秒。
必须为整点分钟
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance.
You can invoke https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157459.html to query the IDs of all Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instances
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS高防实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157459.html查询所有DDoS高防实例的ID信息
parameters.name: instance_ids

PortMaxConns.description_en: The peak connection information of ports on the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance
PortMaxConns.description_zh: DDoS高防实例的端口连接峰值信息

Cps.description_en: The maximum number of connections per second

Ip.description_en: The IP address of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance

Port.description_en: The port of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance
